features.name: ingest_idempotent_store
features.title: Live SSE ingest into an idempotent SQLite store
features.description: Drink from Wikimedia EventStreams (recentchange) over SSE, normalize to the domain event, and persist idempotently to SQLite. Reconnect with bounded exponential backoff and resume via Last-Event-ID. Replaying the same events leaves row counts unchanged.
acceptance: Live events land in SQLite; replaying the same events leaves row counts unchanged
Connection drops trigger reconnect with bounded backoff + jitter and resume via Last-Event-ID
SIGINT/context cancellation drains the pipeline and exits 0
A stats output reports received/persisted/duplicate counters
go test ./... -race -count=1 green: table-driven tests plus an httptest fake source (happy path, malformed JSON, drop+resume)

features.name: classification_projections
features.title: Pure rule classifiers and rolling-window projections
features.description: Classify events (bot vs human, size anomaly, wiki heat) with a pure rule engine and compute rolling-window projections (rates, top pages, leaderboards). No I/O: pure functions, table-driven tests. Introduces the worker pool over the classification port.
acceptance: Classifiers are pure functions covered by table-driven tests
Rolling windows answer rate/top/leaderboard queries from the store
Worker pool fans out over the classification port with graceful drain
Race detector clean under concurrent classification

features.name: live_dashboard
features.title: SSE fan-out dashboard
features.description: Fan out classified events and projections to browsers over SSE and render a lightweight dashboard (live table + charts).
acceptance: Multiple concurrent dashboard clients receive live events without affecting ingest throughput
Slow dashboard clients do not block the pipeline (per-client buffers, drop policy)

features.name: ai_scoring
features.title: AI embeddings worker, anomaly scoring and mini-RAG CLI
features.description: Phase 2 of the learning plan: a batch embeddings worker with rate limiting and exponential backoff behind a domain port, LLM-backed anomaly scoring of edits, and a mini-RAG CLI over the stored history.
acceptance: Embeddings worker respects rate limits and backs off exponentially on 429/5xx
Anomaly scoring runs behind a port with a deterministic fake for tests
Mini-RAG CLI answers questions over stored history with a local model
AI adapters never leak into the domain package
